name: Floating Lanterns
desc: A drift of warm paper sky-lanterns ascending in parallax, glow breathing on the swell, with one large lantern occasionally crossing the foreground.

density.doc: number of lanterns in the stream

hue.doc: paper/flame base hue (32=amber; try 12 red, 200 cold)

style.doc: paper=translucent warm shade w/ ribs / riso=2-ink misregistered print + halftone / ember=hot false-color light blobs / wireframe=glowing schematic ribs, no fill (abstract) / noir=chiaroscuro light-from-dark, no outline

act.doc: release=steady rising stream / gust=wind pushes them sideways in slow waves / vigil=few large lanterns, slow sacred ascent
